title: Iris Murdoch artworks from secret room go on display – including self-portrait

paragraphs.en: For decades, they lay in a secret room in her attic gathering dust. Now, newly discovered artworks by the Booker prize-winning author Iris Murdoch – including the only self-portrait she is known to have painted, four surrealist landscape paintings and three sketches of female nudes – will go on display for the first time on Friday.
paragraphs.zh: 几十年来，它们一直躺在她阁楼的一间密室里积灰。如今，布克奖得主作家艾丽丝·默多克新发现的艺术作品——包括已知她画过的唯一一幅自画像、四幅超现实主义风景画和三幅女性裸体素描——将于周五首次展出。

paragraphs.en: The artworks were created at the start of the second world war when Murdoch was a student at Oxford. They expose her early interest in surrealism and fascination with the naked female form.
paragraphs.zh: 这些作品创作于第二次世界大战初期，当时默多克还是牛津大学的学生。它们展现出她对超现实主义的早期兴趣，以及对女性裸体的迷恋。

paragraphs.en: Until now, Murdoch was only known to have created three paintings in her lifetime.
paragraphs.zh: 此前，人们只知道默多克一生中创作过三幅画。

paragraphs.en: In total, more than 80 new artworks by the novelist were discovered last year at Murdoch’s former home in north Oxford by Dr Miles Leeson, director of the Iris Murdoch Research Centre at the University of Chichester.
paragraphs.zh: 去年，奇切斯特大学艾丽丝·默多克研究中心主任迈尔斯·利森博士在默多克位于牛津北部的旧居中，总共发现了这位小说家 80 多件新的艺术作品。

paragraphs.en: He was invited by the executors of Murdoch’s estate to explore 30 Charlbury Road after the death of Audi Bayley, the second wife of Murdoch’s late husband, John Bayley, who lived there until 2024.
paragraphs.zh: 在默多克已故丈夫约翰·贝利的第二任妻子奥迪·贝利于 2024 年去世后，默多克遗产的执行人邀请利森去勘察查尔伯里路 30 号，奥迪·贝利在那里一直住到 2024 年。

paragraphs.en: Murdoch, who died in 1999 and was known to be a hoarder, had stashed the paintings and sketches in a secret room in her attic. The door was hidden behind a large bookcase. “It was inaccessible,” Leeson said. “It was like an inner sanctum.”
paragraphs.zh: 默多克于 1999 年去世，以囤积成癖著称，她把那些画作和素描藏在了阁楼的一间密室里。门隐藏在一个大书柜后面。“那里进不去，”利森说，“就像一间内殿。”

paragraphs.en: He suspects no one had been inside the room for decades and that only Murdoch and her husband were aware of its existence.
paragraphs.zh: 他怀疑几十年来没有人进过那个房间，只有默多克和她的丈夫知道它的存在。

paragraphs.en: “I don’t think Audi knew about it,” he said. “I don’t think anybody knew about it … there were a lot of personal effects and items in there. Really private stuff.”
paragraphs.zh: “我想奥迪不知道它，”他说，“我想谁都不知道……里面有很多私人物品和物件，真正私密的东西。”
